boundary_loading_note: boundary_wkt is VARCHAR staging text; validate before optional GEOGRAPHY conversion. Coordinates are longitude first in WKT.
format: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one JSON object per row; explicit JSON nulls; never NaN/Infinity
null_loading_note: Future Snowflake scalar projection must map JSON null to SQL NULL explicitly; do not replace null with zero.

BASELINE_TRACT_SCORES.description: Source dataset fingerprint, shared with processed tracts/stations.
Foreign key to TRACTS_PROCESSED within the dataset.
Straight-line Haversine distance to supplied station inventory, including SIR.
0-1 normalized reciprocal-income component; neutral fallback is 0.5.
Missing/nonpositive income uses neutral component; reported income is not imputed.
Configured weighted sum; null for ineligible tracts.
Descending residential rank; minimum rank for ties, null if ineligible.

SCORING_RUNS.description: Unique export/scoring run identifier; may be supplied for traceability.
Effective distance/population/income weights from scorer metadata.
All baseline lower/upper factor bounds, reusable by future scenarios.
Complete scorer DataFrame attributes, including policies and distance method.
Named input hashes/byte sizes, loader report, code hashes; source vintages unconfirmed.
Formula, interpretation, geographic scope, policies and limitations.

STATION_LOCATIONS.description: loc_ plus SHA256 of exact numeric coordinates; not a physical station ID.
Lexicographically first distinct source name; not a verified official identity.
Sorted JSON array of all distinct source names, including canonical name.
Sorted JSON array of parent station IDs retained by the loader.
Multiple GTFS parent IDs share these coordinates; requires review.
More than one distinct name shares this coordinate location.
Always false: coordinate deduplication does not establish physical identity.
Explanation for flagged identity ambiguity; null otherwise.

TRACTS_PROCESSED.description: SHA256 of the five named source file hashes.
11-digit tract identifier; always a string.
Source BoroName.
Source CTLabel, preserved as text.
Source NTAName.
WGS84 interior reference point latitude, degrees.
WGS84 interior reference point longitude, degrees.
WKT serialized from loader Shapely geometry; EPSG:4326, lon first.
Loader geometry validation status.
Finite coordinates within global latitude/longitude ranges.
Inside documented broad NYC envelope; not a jurisdiction test.
Reported total population, including observed zeros.
Loader population missingness flag.
Unaltered Census population estimate text.
Source margin of error text; not numerically modeled.
Reported dollars; top-coded values are lower bounds, not exact estimates.
True for unavailable reported income; no income imputation.
True for a reported upper top-code such as 250,000+.
Unaltered income estimate text, including Census markers.
Source margin of error text, including Census markers.
Positive population; zero-population rows remain in the table.
